🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — September 11, 2026

Sun, in Virgo, holds a sextile to Mars, in its fall in Cancer. Two different appetites, forced into one conversation: what you already own finally finds the words to be counted.

Easier — Agreeing on a figure without feeling robbed by it.
Harder — Agreeing to something because agreeing feels pleasant.
Backdrop — Jupiter and Saturn hold a month-long trine underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you from Cancer, where it stands lowest. From Libra, Mercury quotes your worth back at you. Fire that starts things, billed for starting. The hold Mercury had a week ago is not there any more.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. Sun trines you from Virgo, and what you hold finds words unforced. Earth that holds on, holding without strain. Venus has been out of Libra for four weeks now.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Libra, where nothing is owed to it. Sun squares you from Virgo, and the cost objects. Mutable air keeps two accounts open and pays both. Mercury has not been in Leo for four weeks.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, moves through Virgo unannounced. Mars is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Cardinal water opens and closes the same file. The sextile to Jupiter that held a week ago has let go.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, crosses Virgo untitled. Mercury in Libra opens a gap you have to step into. Fixed fire keeps what it has, and keeping is easy. Since Sun crossed out of Leo, the question has changed.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, holds no rank in Libra and simply works. From Cancer, Mars makes something possible and nothing certain. Mutable earth: two answers, neither expensive. Moon let go of it a week ago.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. From Cancer, Mars sets a figure against the wanting. Air opens the file, and the file has a price. The opposition of two weeks ago is off it now.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you, fallen in Cancer. Sun in Virgo makes room for you, and then waits. Fixed water: nothing needs letting go of today. Since early September, Mars has moved 18° and changed nothing.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Sun squares you from Virgo: wanting and cost refuse to agree. Fire that changes shape, charged for each shape. Unchanged for four weeks: you know what it asks.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Mars in Cancer stands opposite, and what you value is quoted back. Earth moves first and pays first. Four weeks of it, long enough to have stopped noticing.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. From Libra, Mercury concedes the point early. Fixed air holds, and holding asks nothing back. A week ago Saturn was still held by Moon; that is finished.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. From Virgo, Sun returns your estimate with corrections. Mutable water: every option kept is an option paid for. What pressed a week ago has cleared.
